GOOD TO KNOW

A few answers.

How does Kivi work?+

Kivi stays on your screen. Place your cursor in an app, activate Kivi, and speak. Your words appear directly in the text field.

Can I try it here?+

These interactive samples preview the experience. They don’t record audio or connect to the desktop app.

Can I use my own language?+

Kivi supports voice typing and translation for Indian languages. Explore the native-script examples above.
